scene_policy.rules: Large furniture, chairs, lamps, plants and columns stand on the floor. Small items may stand on the floor or on a declared flat table/cabinet/desk surface with their full footprint supported; shelf items may also rest on a bookcase shelf board with their full footprint on that board. Screens (TV, monitor, laptop) must stand on such a surface. Tall storage stays near the back wall. A seat within seat_reach_m of a table or desk is a seat at it and must face it (facing relation). A screen standing on a table or desk that has a seat facing it must itself face that seat, so its display - not its back - is toward the person.

constraints.evidence: Actual host coverage plus named scored board height
Actual projected footprint covered on named host within height tolerance
Actual host coverage plus named scored board height

native_rules.on_top_of: Full projected footprint covered by actual upward host triangles within 1cm; not envelope top
native_rules.touching: Actual surface-distance witness <=1cm; no excessive intersection
native_rules.visual: Actual mesh 80x60 ray-hit silhouette/occlusion; centre is projected actual bounds centre
native_rules.asset_identity: IDs are stable legacy identifiers; do not infer native material colour from ID suffix
